field_encodings.element_rule: 32-byte little-endian canonical encoding (< p); an integer, tag or mask is one element; a 32-byte SHA-256 digest or identifier is two u128 limbs, low half first; a commitment, chain, Poseidon root or nonce is one element
field_encodings.poseidon_rule: Poseidon(domain, items) = iroha_pasta hash_with_domain (RP57); digests are pinned by the proof owner with the artifact set (owner question Q2)

norito_header.crc64_rule: CRC-64/XZ of the payload, stored little-endian; crc64_hex is big-endian

signature_boundaries.derivation: r = x(k*G) mod n; s = floor(n/2); e = SHA-256(preimage) mod n; d = (s*k - e) * r^-1 mod n; public key Q = d*G

signature_rule: ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over preimage_hex; RFC 6979 from the fixed scalars, frozen to low S; a consumer accepts iff codec_ok and verify_ok

signatures.object: Receive receipt binding the Payment digest

stand_ins.field_value_rule: seed s: 31 bytes s followed by s & 0x3f (little-endian, canonical)
stand_ins.lineage_proof_byte_rule: Ω transport proof byte i = (i + 7) mod 251; CreditStatus Ω(h): (i + 11) mod 251
stand_ins.note: labelled stand-in values: proof bytes, relation bindings and empty-map roots are fixed by the G3 artifact set and map owner; vectors that depend on them change then
